electrode_display.rule: Reuse current E panel rigid rod projections; schematic display only, no simulation coordinates or readout traces changed.

layout_refinement.left_circuit_anchor: Preserve left edge and vertical center; scale original artwork uniformly by 1.20. Recenter title above the enlarged frame.
layout_refinement.sheet_scale_anchor: Preserve the v6 sheet center; uniformly enlarge width and height by 1.06.

panel_a.kernel_arrows: Removed to distinguish neuronal symbols from arrows; ellipse orientation conveys anisotropy.

readout.type: normalized Gaussian average of smoothed E spike density
readout.quantity: Firing-density proxy, not an electric/magnetic field or synaptic-current LFP.
readout.waveform_quantity: Actual frozen F-panel 30-80 Hz traces; all contacts share the same amplitude scale.
readout.display_title_meaning: Virtual SEEG contact readout of underlying SNN propagation; firing-density proxy, not measured clinical voltage or a newly computed potential forward model.

mode_showcases.observable: Frozen 30-80 Hz contact activity from the F source arrays, cropped to two 120-ms three-contact burst sequences.
mode_showcases.distinction_from_F: A: two short three-contact mechanism readouts, fixed channel order, shared gain; F: continuous 15-contact long record and event marks.
mode_showcases.selection: Reuse F events 10/8 and their existing 120-ms windows; use the three consecutive contacts ICL3/ICL4/ICL5. SL3/SL4/SL5 are author-requested display aliases, identically mapped in the sampling view and readouts; no time shifting or per-channel gain.

panel_a.readout_peak_order: MTA strictly descending; MTB ascending with an ICL3/ICL4 tie at the original 2-ms sampling resolution.
panel_a.data_lineage: Overview and sampling zoom share frozen illustrative neurons and E-panel rigid rod display coordinates. SEEG readout means virtual-contact SNN activity; both bursts are exact 120-ms waveform crops from F events 10 and 8, not measured voltage or graph recovery.

panel_b.prior_interpretation: Stages 1-5 belong to the preceding label-informed development phase and are omitted from B. Subsequent searches inherit its candidate pool and patient geometry as development priors; their scoring objectives omit TA/TB labels. This display restriction does not establish independence from development data or remove historical information use.

panel_i.metric: two separate signed Spearman correlations; no minimum or cross-match penalty

source_metadata_correction: The frozen source summary incorrectly states that patient data do not enter workpoint selection; this registry interpretation supersedes that sentence without changing source arrays or scores.
